title: Garden Bug Hunt
hook: Ask what it does before you decide what it means.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: friendly 3D garden-insect storybook, leafy greens and flower accents, close-up clean subjects, no clutter

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child mapping ecological roles without moralizing animals
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written ecological role and safety; spiders explicit non-insect
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: role cue -> recall beat -> target -> observe/point gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a clave tap followed by a short glockenspiel wing-answer.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a clave tap followed by a short glockenspiel wing-answer
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Garden Bug Hunt an ecological-role map: pollinator, plant feeder, predator, decomposer, aquatic-juvenile visitor, nuisance and disease-vector risks all occupy different relationships in one garden.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child asks what each tiny creature is doing in the garden rather than whether it is 'good' or 'bad'.
